author: skyzenn_00
quote: After 13 years of waiting for this new installment in the Grand Theft Auto series, I'm disappointed.

author: skyzenn_00
quote: This is incredibly disappointing for a game that has been hyped for so many years.Rockstar seems to have forgotten what made GTA great in the first place. GTA is supposed to be a crime sandbox where players have freedom to experiment, cause chaos, break rules and have fun. Instead, so much of the experience feels restricted, scripted and unnecessarily controlled. What's the point of creating such a massive open world if the game constantly limits what you can actually do in it?The writing is another disappointment. The characters lack the depth, charisma and memorable personalities that made previous GTA protagonists so iconic. The dialogue and character interactions often feel forced, and the story seems more interested in pushing its preferred messaging than delivering genuinely compelling **** increasingly obvious DEI and woke-oriented approach also feels distracting when it comes at the expense of natural storytelling. Representation itself isn't the problem. Poorly written characters and forced messaging are. A character should be interesting because of their personality, motivations and development, not because of what demographic box they **** gunplay is another major letdown. Combat should feel satisfying and responsive, but the shooting mechanics feel unnecessarily clunky. For a game with this much emphasis on crime and action, that's a fundamental problem.Then there's the performance. The optimization is disappointing, the frame-rate limitations are frustrating, and the technical experience doesn't feel worthy of a release carrying this much anticipation.Ultimately, GTA 6 feels like a game that prioritized cinematic presentation, realism and social messaging over the things that actually make a sandbox enjoyable: freedom, gameplay, memorable characters and fun.Rockstar spent years building expectations, but beautiful graphics and an enormous map cannot compensate for weak gameplay decisions.A technical showcase is not the same thing as a great video game.
